title: Atlanta Journal-Constitution Features Liv Labs
body_markdown:
Liv Labs Press Release


Jun 9, 2024


Aging in Atlanta cover story


Liv Labs Inc., a consumer healthtech company making innovative solutions for urinary incontinence, was recently featured on the front page of the Atlanta Journal-Constitution’s Aging in Atlanta special section along with articles about dating, cruises and senior living community!


Link to story at: https://rct.coxnewspapers.com/aging/June-9-2024.pdf
